scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix ./src/backend && npm install --prefix ./src/local-server && npm install --prefix ./src/overwolf-app && npm install --prefix ./src/web
scripts.dev: sh -c 'npm run dev:backend & backend=$!; npm run dev:web & web=$!; trap "kill $backend $web" INT TERM EXIT; wait'
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix ./src/backend && npm run build --prefix ./src/local-server && npm run build --prefix ./src/web
